dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Datasets explicitly named in the paper and supplementary tables map to the listed minor categories. OpenNeuro transfer datasets are captured as MULTI-SITE (N>=2). Other site labels in Supplementary files 1-2 that do not map to a provided minor category are marked as Unknown.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Many sites were pulled from publicly available datasets including ABCD, CAMCAN, CMI-HBN, HCP-Aging, HCP-Development, HCP-Early Psychosis, HCP-Young Adult, NKI-RS, OpenNeuro, PNC, and UKBiobank."; "We leverage several datasets for the benchmarking tasks, the Human Connectome Project Young Adult study (HCP) ... The Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) ... and the University of Michigan SchizGaze (UMich) ..."; "Supplementary file 2. Surface Area Normative Model Demographics. Description: For each included site, we show the sample size (N), age (mean, standard deviation), and sex distribution (Female/Male percent) of the normative models of surface area extracted for all regions of interest in the Destrieux Freesurfer atlas."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling; Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Dataset selection and scanner parameters; Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Supplementary file descriptions

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Purposes are taken from the benchmarking description and the functional model training/testing and transfer descriptions. Surface area dataset purpose is based on Supplementary file 2 being the demographics for the surface area normative model.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We leverage several datasets for the benchmarking tasks, the Human Connectome Project Young Adult study (HCP) ... The Center for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE) ... and the University of Michigan SchizGaze (UMich) ..."; "The HCP data was used in the prediction - regression benchmarking task. The COBRE and UMich datasets are used in the classification and group difference testing benchmarking tasks."; "Training and testing datasets (80/20) were created ... To show generalizability of the models to new data not included in training, we leveraged three datasets (ds000243, ds002843, ds003798) from OpenNeuro.org to create a multi-site transfer dataset."; "Supplementary file 2. Surface Area Normative Model Demographics. Description: For each included site, we show the sample size (N), age (mean, standard deviation), and sex distribution (Female/Male percent) of the normative models of surface area extracted for all regions of interest in the Destrieux Freesurfer atlas."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Dataset selection and scanner parameters; Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Functional Brain Networks Normative Modeling; Rutherford2023.pdf.md: Supplementary file descriptions

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Functional model N totals are summed across per-site train/test counts in Supplementary file 1. Surface area total N is summed across site Ns in Supplementary file 2. Structural model N is reported as approximately 58,000 in the main text; train-phase not reported.
